builder.redaction_note: builder.interpreter was an absolute path on the build host; redacted at publish time. SHA256SUMS regenerated for MANIFEST.json only. Artifact digests (dli.pyz, wheel) are unchanged and were produced by the build.

notes: Built with the venv interpreter (pip egress); never installed into the system interpreter. build_sha/tier_sha/version are baked literals (dli_dist/_build_stamp.py) — the environment cannot forge them (F7). Each artifact was swept by tools/check_pkg_no_network_imports.py (F8).

skipped.reason: skipped: the onefile is not shipped. It vendors CPython stdlib network clients that cannot be removed (sweep of its embedded PYZ found: ['socket', 'urllib']); it is not byte-reproducible (PyInstaller embeds an absolute build path and a per-build timestamp); and it cannot be swept from the target interpreter, which has no PyInstaller. The wheel and zipapp carry only dli_dist's stdlib-only source and no network-client members.
